_about: Bracket pick'em (Salah, 2026-11-15: a March Madness kind of bracket for AFCON, the Euros and so on; no money, no odds, picks kept on the device). formats: how a group stage feeds the knockouts. advance: places that go through from every group; thirds: how many third-placed teams go through; thirdsVs: the group winners who meet a third-placed team, in the order of each row of table; table: for each set of groups whose thirds go through (letters in order), the group of the third each of thirdsVs meets. six-four is the 24-team format of AFCON (since 2019) and the Euros of 2016 and 2020, from the Euro 2016 regulations (Wikipedia, UEFA Euro 2016 knockout stage, CC BY-SA 4.0); its CDEF row is the one AFCON 2025 used, and gives that tournament's real last 16. brackets: one per tournament; groups by FIFA code as in nations.json (tournaments.json hide still applies); a knockout side is a place (1A, 2C), the third who meets a group winner (3vs1A), or the winner of an earlier game (W:R16-1).

brackets.name: AFCON 2025
brackets.practice: A practice bracket: the real draw of the 2025 finals in Morocco. Picks for 2027 open when its draw is made.
